blog.title: API Security Best Practices
blog.description: Learn how to protect your APIs from common vulnerabilities and follow security best practices to keep your applications safe.
blog.author: CodMonks Team
blog.content:
# Authentication
            Always use OAuth 2.0 or JWTs.

            # Rate Limiting
            Prevent abuse with throttling and quotas.

            # Data Validation
            Sanitize all inputs to avoid injection attacks.

            # Encryption
            Use HTTPS and encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit.
blog.htmlContent:
# Authentication
        Always use OAuth 2.0 or JWTs.

        # Rate Limiting
        Prevent abuse with throttling and quotas.

        # Data Validation
        Sanitize all inputs to avoid injection attacks.

        # Encryption
        Use HTTPS and encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit.
